evidence.domain_standard: Craft Yarn Council standardized crochet chart symbols are the reference vocabulary; CYC identifies chain, slip stitch, single crochet, half double crochet, double crochet, treble, double treble, clusters, shells and picot symbols as standardized readable chart notation. CYC also states gauge should be followed for the actual pattern and is especially variable for lace/openwork.
